source: Phase 7C mathematical/software fixtures, 2026-09-07; not engineering sensor evidence
label: TEST-ONLY; NOT FLIGHT TUNING

p0_diagonal.units: first three rad^2; last three rad^2/s^2

qc_diagonal.units: first three rad^2/s; last three rad^2/s^3

vector_weight.meaning: positive conditioning weight, NOT measurement noise or a calibrated covariance

maximum_residual.meaning: test-only local-basin rejection, no flight gate selected

minimum_acquisition_sine.meaning: test-only geometry rejection, no operational threshold selected

acquisition_pair_tolerance.meaning: TEST-ONLY ideal-pair consistency, not an installed sensor threshold

max_events.meaning: additional bounded-memory cap, covers 3 s of 100 Hz gyro plus vector events

gyro_substeps.meaning: TEST-ONLY offline angular-rate interpolation; production timing unchanged

truth_duration.meaning: algorithm case duration, not a requirement

sun_reference_n.units: arbitrary vector normalized by the harness
sun_reference_n.meaning: synthetic inertial Sun direction, not an ephemeris or CSS model

prior_error.meaning: explicit perturbed-prior test, not deployment knowledge

notes: All numerical entries are ASSUMED TEST-ONLY fixture choices for conditioning, convergence and failure tests. Q/R/P0 are not installed HS-2 values. No flight configuration imports this file. Noise-free does not imply zero initial uncertainty or a nonsingular zero-R update.
